title: 真实搭讪 男朋友出现

timeline.summary: The male camera-holder greets three seated women and starts a request that the ASR renders as asking for WeChat.
After a broken ASR fragment, the on-screen subtitle clearly reads ‘我想有男朋友’ (I want a boyfriend). The automatic transcript is too unclear to establish the following words or turn boundaries.
Another man enters or passes through the scene, the camera-holder walks away, and laughter is audible. The clip does not establish who the man is or why the interaction ends.

claims.statement: The visible subtitle records the woman saying ‘I want a boyfriend’; this is not the same as saying that she already has one.
claims.conditions: The subtitle is visually clear, while the ASR and exact speaker-turn timing are uncertain; no broader intent or consent inference is permitted.
